source.author: verg
source.text: Nonne vides, croceos ut Tmolus odores, India mittit ebur, molles sua tura Sabaei, at Chalybes nudi ferrum, virosaque Pontus castorea, Eliadum palmas Epiros equarum.
source.text_original: Nonne vides, croceos ut Tmolus odores, / India mittit ebur, molles sua tura Sabaei, / at Chalybes nudi ferrum, virosaque Pontus / castorea, Eliadum palmas Epiros equarum.
source.text_english: Do you not see how Tmolus sends saffron scents, India ivory, the soft Sabaeans their frankincense, but the naked Chalybes iron, Pontus virile castoreum, and Epirus the palm prizes of the mares of Elis?

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: At Calybes duri ferrum, virosaque Pontus Castorea, et caetera.
reuse.text_original: At Calybes duri ferrum, virosaque Pontus Castorea, et caetera.
reuse.text_english: But Calybes for hard iron, Pontus for manly Castor, and the rest.
